newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish fixed bond yields seen flat at Wed tender.
newsitem.headline: Polish fixed bond yields seen flat at Wed tender.

text.p: Maximum yields of Polish two- and five-year fixed bonds are likely to stay flat at Wednesday's 800 million zloty tender with a change in finance minister unlikely to disturb the market, analysts said.

Finance Minister Grzegorz Kolodko quit on Tuesday saying he did not want to be sucked into the campaigning for parliamentary polls later this year. He was replaced by the presidential economic adviser Marek Belka.
"I do not expect bond yields to rise and or to fall on the Kolodko news," said Marcin Rzechowski, bond dealer at PBI SA.
Analysts expected the maximum yield of the two-year bonds to hover around last auction's 20.65 percent and the maximum yield of the five year to stay around 18.50 percent.
Dealers said demand at the tender would likely match the offer and should evenly spread between the shorter, 15-percent bond, and the longer 12-percent paper.

Foreign investors, who bought a significant amount of fixed bonds in early January after Kolodko announced Polish plans to fulfill European Monetary Union entry requirements by 2004, were likely to take a wait-and-see stance after Kolodko's resignation.
"We would like to wait and see if Mr Belka stays on the present course of reforms," one dealer at a London investment bank said, adding he did not expect any major changes.
"Kolodko's departure means little from an economic angle," one foreign dealer said.
The value date for the shorter, two-year paper, due June 12, 1999, is February 12, 1997 and the same value date is for the longer, five-year bond, due June 12, 2002.
The bonds come from a new three billion zloty issue of two- and five-year fixed bonds which will be offered at four consecutive tenders from February to May.

The ministry moved the deadline for this auction to 1100 local time (1000 GMT) from the regular 1200 to announce the results earlier than usual and so that investors could start payment procedures on the day of the tender. -- Krzysztof Wojcik +48 22 653 9700
